Initial release of the Build Brand Design FAQ Page skill.

- Generates customer-facing answers to common brand design questions.
- Designed for use by designers, brand teams, and ecommerce operators creating FAQ content.
- Includes a clear step-by-step workflow for drafting and refining FAQ pages.
- Optimized for SEO with targeted keywords for brand design and creative automation.
- Integrates with chat and web search APIs for enhanced content generation.
